class.name: Vehicle
class.brief_description: A fully simulated vehicle with suspension, steering, engine, gearbox, clutch, driveshaft, and aerodynamics.
class.description:
Vehicle is a [RigidBody3D] that simulates a multi-axle vehicle with a complete drivetrain. It uses [Axle] children to group wheels and distributes torque based on each axle's drive ratio. The engine, clutch, gearbox, driveshaft, and aerodynamics are simulated internally.
Configure via resource properties: [SuspensionData], [VehicleEngineData], [GearboxData], [TireData], [VehicleAerodynamicsData].
Input is provided each physics frame through [member throttle_input], [member steer_input], [member brake_input], and [member shift_input].

method.name: set_suspension_data
method.description: Sets the [SuspensionData] resource for configuring suspension (spring rate, damping, anti-roll bar).

method.name: get_suspension_data
method.description: Returns the [SuspensionData] resource.

method.name: set_engine_data
method.description: Sets the [VehicleEngineData] resource for configuring the engine (torque curve, idle/redline RPM, inertia, drag).

method.name: get_engine_data
method.description: Returns the [VehicleEngineData] resource.

method.name: set_gearbox_data
method.description: Sets the [GearboxData] resource for configuring gear ratios, final drive, clutch torque, and shift times.

method.name: get_gearbox_data
method.description: Returns the [GearboxData] resource.

method.name: set_tire_data
method.description: Sets the [TireData] resource for configuring tire grip, radius, brake power, peak slip angle, and relaxation.

method.name: get_tire_data
method.description: Returns the [TireData] resource.

method.name: set_aero_data
method.description: Sets the [VehicleAerodynamicsData] resource for configuring drag, downforce, and yaw damping.

method.name: get_aero_data
method.description: Returns the [VehicleAerodynamicsData] resource.

method.name: set_throttle_input
method.description: Sets the throttle input (0.0 to 1.0). Values outside this range are clamped.

method.name: get_throttle_input
method.description: Returns the current throttle input value (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: set_steer_input
method.description: Sets the steering input (-1.0 to 1.0, negative = left, positive = right). The steering rack smooths and rate-limits this value internally.

method.name: get_steer_input
method.description: Returns the raw steering input value (-1.0 to 1.0).

method.name: set_brake_input
method.description: Sets the brake input (0.0 to 1.0). Values outside this range are clamped.

method.name: get_brake_input
method.description: Returns the current brake input value (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: set_shift_input
method.description: Sets the shift input (-1 = shift down, 0 = none, 1 = shift up). For semi-automatic mode only; ignored in automatic mode.

method.name: get_shift_input
method.description: Returns the current shift input (-1, 0, or 1).

method.name: set_substeps
method.description: Sets the number of physics substeps per frame. Higher values improve drivetrain stability at the cost of performance. Range: 1 to 128.

method.name: get_substeps
method.description: Returns the number of physics substeps per frame.

method.name: get_speed_kph
method.description: Returns the vehicle's current speed in kilometers per hour.

method.name: get_exhaust_smoke
method.description: Returns the current exhaust smoke intensity (0.0 to 1.0) based on engine load and RPM.

method.name: get_exhaust_heat
method.description: Returns the current exhaust heat intensity (0.0 to 1.0) for visual effects.

method.name: get_exhaust_flame_probability
method.description: Returns the probability (0.0 to 1.0) of exhaust flames occurring this frame, based on engine conditions like high RPM and fuel cut.

members.member: Resource configuring the vehicle's suspension (spring rate, damping, anti-roll bar).
Resource configuring the vehicle's engine (torque curve, RPM limits, inertia).
Resource configuring the gearbox and clutch (ratios, shift times, clutch torque).
Resource configuring tire parameters (grip, radius, peak slip angle, relaxation).
Resource configuring aerodynamics (drag, downforce, yaw damping coefficient).
If [code]true[/code], the anti-lock braking system actively modulates brake pressure to prevent wheel lockup.
If [code]true[/code], traction control reduces engine torque when wheel slip exceeds the threshold.
[TurboData] resource configuring turbocharger behavior (spool rates, max boost, RPM ranges).
Shift input (-1 = shift down, 0 = none, 1 = shift up).
Number of physics substeps per frame (1 to 1024).
